synopsis.summary: Fix itr-compiler batch parsing and CU layout: key-order-independent JSON/YAML parsing (bug-1), inline-section to components splitting so Advisor batches compile to four-file CU folders (bug-2), and a hard enforcement failure naming the CU and missing sections instead of emitting flat blobs.

cus.content: ARCH rules for bugfix-feature-2 (itr-compiler batch parsing and CU layout fix). Hexagonal architecture: domain models in itrcompiler.domain.models; compile orchestration in itrcompiler.application.services; CLI parsing in itrcompiler.control.cli; filesystem access only via itrcompiler.infrastructure.filesystem. No cross-layer dependencies. Port flow outbound to inbound. Parsing fixes stay inside itrcompiler.infrastructure.parsers (JSONFormat, YAMLFormat). Enforcement stays inside itrcompiler.application.services (RequiredPartsValidation, Compile). The writer (FileSystem.write) keeps its components.nonEmpty branch behavior unchanged; the fix makes the parser feed it correctly. New validation failures must be typed domain errors surfaced with the offending CU id and component name.

LEGEND for bugfix-feature-2. CU = Computational Unit. CU folder = per-CU subdirectory named after the CU id (e.g. cu-001/). COORDINATES.itr = DTR area affected/created by the CU. REQUIREMENTS.itr = what part of the feature the CU adds. IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS.itr = stepwise code instructions for the Coder (gitignored). ACCEPTANCE.itr = per-CU acceptance criteria + acceptance/regression tests. SYNOPSIS.itr = ITR-root file naming implemented features and defining MAX_ATTEMPTS. MAX_ATTEMPTS = max Coder retry count per CU before escalation to code lead (3 for this ITR). Flat blob = a single cu-<id>/cu-<id>.itr file, the bug-2 symptom. New-schema batch = a batch carrying a synopsis and/or at least one component-carrying regular CU; subject to component + synopsis enforcement. Legacy batch = no synopsis, every regular CU component-less; keeps one in-folder <cu-id>.itr frame and is never enforcement-failed.

REQUIREMENTS: Make JSONFormat.parse accept CU object keys in any order (JSON objects are unordered per RFC 8259), so batches round-tripped through key-reordering tooling (sort_keys, formatters, editors) compile. Batches with byte-identical values in different key orders must parse to equal CUBatch results and compile with exit 0 when arch and legend are present. This resolves bug-1 (bug-1-json-batch-key-order-rejected) and feature criteria 1-2. COORDINATES: TYPE.scala.itrcompiler.infrastructure.parsers.JSONFormat.scala.JSONFormat + FILE.scala/itrcompiler/infrastructure/parsers/JSONFormat.scala; a coordinates value may name a DTR area that does not exist yet, meaning the CU creates it. IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS: (1) In itr-compiler/src/main/scala/itrcompiler/infrastructure/parsers/JSONFormat.scala parse(), replace the single cuLocator regex (which hard-codes the cu-id, cu-type, dtr-coordinates, content sequence) with a per-object scan: locate each top-level CU object extent (reuse findObjectExtent), then extract cu-id, optional cu-type, dtr-coordinates, and content independently of order, keeping the iterative parseJsonString content extraction (no regex backtracking, no StackOverflowError on newlines). (2) Keep parseComponentsForCU and parseSynopsis behavior unchanged. (3) Update the class docstring, which currently documents the fixed key order. Do NOT touch YAMLFormat.scala, FileSystem.scala, RequiredPartsValidation.scala, or Compile.scala; do NOT change the serialized output shape. Prove with: sbt "testOnly *JSONFormat*" from itr-compiler/ plus the two CLI repro commands from bug-1 (content-first and cu-id-first batches, both must print Compiled 3 CU(s) with exit 0). Stop when feature test T1 is green; inline-section splitting belongs to cu-002. ACCEPTANCE: Feature test T1 (criteria 1-2): the two minimal bug-1 batches compile via .LLMDD/tools/itr-compiler --compile --json-content <batch> --out-folder <tmp>/ with exit 0 and Compiled 3 CU(s) for both; new unit test sbt "testOnly *JSONFormat* -- -z key-order" asserting equal CUBatch results across key orders is green. Command: sbt "testOnly *JSONFormat*" from itr-compiler/, expected all JSONFormat suites green.

cus.content: REQUIREMENTS: Split the four inline labeled sections (REQUIREMENTS:, COORDINATES:, IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS:, ACCEPTANCE:) in a regular CU's content string into CU.components, so normal Advisor-drafted batches compile to a cu-<id>/ folder holding COORDINATES.itr, REQUIREMENTS.itr, IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS.itr, ACCEPTANCE.itr with no cu-<id>/cu-<id>.itr blob. An explicit "components" object in the batch, when present, wins over splitting. This resolves bug-2 (bug-2-flat-cu-itr-instead-of-folder) and feature criterion 3. COORDINATES: TYPE.scala.itrcompiler.infrastructure.parsers.JSONFormat.scala.JSONFormat + FILE.scala/itrcompiler/infrastructure/parsers/JSONFormat.scala; a coordinates value may name a DTR area that does not exist yet, meaning the CU creates it. IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS: (1) In JSONFormat.scala, add a section splitter that runs after content extraction when the CU has no explicit "components" object: scan content for the four ordered labeled headers (REQUIREMENTS:, COORDINATES:, IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS:, ACCEPTANCE: as documented in the compile-itr skill's CU content bar) and cut the body text between successive headers; populate the components map with keys coordinates, requirements, implementation-steps, acceptance. (2) If all four sections are absent, leave components empty so the legacy path is preserved. Do NOT touch FileSystem.scala (its components.nonEmpty branch already does the right thing), do NOT touch validation or Compile orchestration, do NOT change YAMLFormat in this CU. Prove with: the bug-2 minimal repro (compile /tmp/batch_inline.json, assert four component files exist and no cu-001/cu-001.itr blob) plus new parser unit tests. Stop when feature tests T2 and T3 are green; enforcement belongs to cu-003. ACCEPTANCE: Feature test T2 (criterion 3): compiling the bug-2 /tmp/batch_inline.json yields <out>/cu-001/{COORDINATES,REQUIREMENTS,IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS,ACCEPTANCE}.itr and no <out>/cu-001/cu-001.itr nor <out>/cu-001.itr. Feature test T3 (criterion 4): recompiling .LLMDD/ITRS/feat-1-per-cu-itr-directories/batch.json into an empty folder reproduces the checked-in layout (four component files per cu-001..cu-005, root ARCH.itr/LEGEND.itr, zero cu-*.itr blobs: find <out> -name "cu-*.itr" | wc -l equals 0).

cus.content: REQUIREMENTS: Enforce the flat-CU fix at compile time: compiling a new-schema batch in which any regular CU omits one or more of the four required sections must fail with non-zero exit, naming the offending CU id plus the missing section(s), and must leave no flat cu-<id>.itr blob (at root or inside the CU folder) behind for the offending CU. Genuinely component-less legacy batches keep their single in-folder <cu-id>.itr frame and are never failed (feat-1 criterion 11). This is feature criterion 7. COORDINATES: TYPE.scala.itrcompiler.application.services.RequiredPartsValidation.scala.RequiredPartsValidation + FILE.scala/itrcompiler/application/services/RequiredPartsValidation.scala + TYPE.scala.itrcompiler.application.services.Compile.scala.Compile + FILE.scala/itrcompiler/application/services/Compile.scala; a coordinates value may name a DTR area that does not exist yet, meaning the CU creates it. IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS: (1) In itr-compiler/src/main/scala/itrcompiler/application/services/RequiredPartsValidation.scala, extend the component validation (validateComponents) so it covers split-derived components from cu-002, reporting each offender as CU id + missing component section names; keep the legacy exemption (a batch with no synopsis and zero component-carrying regular CUs skips enforcement). (2) In itr-compiler/src/main/scala/itrcompiler/application/services/Compile.scala, ensure the enforcement failure throws before any frame is written, so no partial flat blob is left behind. Do NOT touch the parsers, do NOT touch FileSystem.scala writer branches, do NOT change the legacy single-blob output. Prove with: the T6 repro below (expect non-zero exit, stderr names CU id + ACCEPTANCE, no blob files) plus the legacy T4 check. Stop when feature tests T6, T4, and T3 are green; YAML parity and the regression suite belong to cu-004. ACCEPTANCE: Feature test T6 (criterion 7): compile a new-schema batch whose regular CU omits ACCEPTANCE; assert non-zero exit, stderr names the CU id and the missing section, and neither <out>/cu-<id>.itr nor <out>/cu-<id>/cu-<id>.itr exists for the offender. Feature test T4 (criteria 5-6): a legacy component-less batch yields <out>/cu-old/cu-old.itr, no <out>/cu-old.itr, no component files.

cus.content: REQUIREMENTS: Bring YAMLFormat to parity (verify its parser has no key-order assumption; fix the same way if it does) and lock the whole fix with regression tests: a JSONFormat key-order unit test, section-splitting unit tests, and an end-to-end integration test that compiles an inline-section batch through Compile + FileSystem and asserts the four-file CU folder layout. Full sbt suite must stay green. This covers the YAML side of criterion 1 and feature criteria 5 and 8. COORDINATES: TYPE.scala.itrcompiler.infrastructure.parsers.YAMLFormat.scala.YAMLFormat + FILE.scala/itrcompiler/infrastructure/parsers/YAMLFormat.scala + TYPE.scala.itrcompiler.infrastructure.parsers.JSONFormat.scala.JSONFormat; a coordinates value may name a DTR area that does not exist yet, meaning the CU creates it. IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS: (1) Read itr-compiler/src/main/scala/itrcompiler/infrastructure/parsers/YAMLFormat.scala: if CU field extraction assumes an order, apply the same order-independent approach as cu-001; if it is already order-independent, add a test proving it and change no production code in that file. (2) Add regression tests: sbt "testOnly *JSONFormat* -- -z key-order" (equal CUBatch across key orders); splitter tests over inline-section contents (all four present, one missing, none present); an integration test mirroring Feat1LayoutTest but starting from a batch JSON string (the real batch-file path, not directly constructed CUs) asserting per-CU four-file folders and no blobs. Do NOT touch FileSystem.scala, RequiredPartsValidation.scala, or Compile.scala in this CU. Prove with: sbt test from itr-compiler/ (expected all suites green, including the pre-existing 87 tests) plus a YAML batch CLI compile. Stop when feature tests T1 (YAML leg), T4, and T5 are green; this is the last CU of the feature. ACCEPTANCE: Feature test T5 (criterion 8): sbt test from itr-compiler/ — all suites green. Feature test T1 YAML leg: a YAML batch with reordered keys compiles exit 0. Feature test T4 legacy check still passes after all changes. Commands: sbt test (expected BUILD SUCCESS), plus .LLMDD/tools/itr-compiler --compile --yaml-content <reordered-batch> --out-folder <tmp>/ expecting exit 0.
